A company filing Form FDA 2512 should submit an amended Form FDA 2512 within 60 days after a cosmetic product is entered into commercial distribution if there are changes to the ingredients or brand name of the product. For other changes, the company must file an amended Form FDA 2512 within one year after such changes occur. Additionally, notice of discontinuance of commercial distribution should be submitted via Form FDA 2514 within 180 days after discontinuance is known. [1]

The provision requires that changes to the ingredients or brand name must be reported by filing an amended Form FDA 2512 within 60 days after the product enters commercial distribution. [1]  
Other changes, not specified as ingredient or brand name modifications, should also be reported by filing an amended Form FDA 2512 within one year of occurrence. [1]  
Notice of discontinuance must be submitted via Form FDA 2514 within 180 days after the discontinuance is known to the filer. [1]
